title: Classic theme and tile spacing

cards.title: Classic theme
cards.body: A clean, grid-only layout with nothing above it. Pick it in *Settings > Visuals > Themes*.

cards.title: Tile gap
cards.body: How much air sits between tiles is now yours to set, in Theme Settings, and it applies to every theme rather than one.

cards.title: Smoother, and more accurate
cards.body: Scrolling hiccups on the Shelf theme are gone, Steam playtime is fetched on better timing, and the usual round of performance work and polish came along with it.

changelog: New: *Classic theme*, a clean grid-only layout.
New: Tile gap option in Theme Settings, works across all themes.
Fixed scrolling hiccups on the Shelf theme.
Updated retrieval timing for Steam playtime data.
Several other performance improvements, bug fixes, and UI polish.
